before.scope: synthetic owned temporary tree only; no real user file

contract: Refuse output symlinks, hardlinks, special types/modes and incompatible ownership before publication.
Refuse literal parent symlinks and unsafe final output directory.
Normal concatenation bytes and CLI hash/length unchanged. New output is a private temporary plus rename.
Identical existing output keeps inode/mtime; mode becomes 600. Different content remains unchanged.
Failed rename removes only its own temporary.
limits: Synthetic filesystem and CLI proof only; no new phone boot.
Not a defense against concurrent edits by another process of the same user.
Does not authenticate all input artifacts or implement bounded artifact parsing.
Output may be outside the repository in an owned canonical directory.
